profile.name: Kevin Wang
profile.title: Senior Backend / Systems / Integration Engineer
profile.summary: Backend, systems, and integration engineer with 13+ years of experience taking over real production systems, defining boundaries between services and vendors, and turning messy workflows into reliable software.
profile.tagline: I turn fragmented systems into reliable production workflows.
profile.availability: Open to remote Senior Backend / Systems / Integration roles

experience.summary: Own and evolve existing production systems spanning customer operations, messaging, integrations, data, deployment, and reliability.
highlights: Operate a notification platform delivering 1M+ push notifications and 50K+ SMS messages per day across five SMS providers.
Own a customer-operations platform deployed to Azure Web App with VM and SQL-backed services; improved a 12-tab user view from blocking full-page loading to independently loaded and refreshable tabs.
Use application-side revalidation plus downstream state checks for operations that mutate external system state.
Maintain C#/.NET and SQL Server services across Azure and IIS, with production monitoring through Application Insights.

experience.summary: Maintained and evolved a long-lived budgeting and accounting platform serving 3,300+ schools and roughly 15,000 users.
highlights: Evolved .NET Framework / SQL Server production workflows while preserving compatibility with older fiscal-year data.
Introduced new fields incrementally rather than forcing incompatible schema assumptions onto historical records.
Supported decision-period aggregation by moving shared summary work to overnight processing when many schools needed the same calculations in a short window.
Owned production maintenance, reporting, SQL troubleshooting, and ongoing business-rule changes.

experience.summary: Designed the ETL pipeline and co-designed the backend calculation model for a multi-store incentive-calculation system.
highlights: Designed Oracle-to-SQL Server ETL flows for data from roughly 6–7 high-volume retail stores.
Handled incomplete records, encoding problems, invalid characters, failed records, and orphan data with explicit classification and replay paths.
Implemented complex incentive rules varying by store, product category, team, and specific products.
Replaced extensive manual report cross-referencing with system calculation so HR could focus on validation.
